turns.learner: Hello! I have an English exam soon. Can we practise going to for plans?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Good idea to practise before your exam. First, a quick question: which three words do we use with "going to" for the subject "I", "he" and "they"?

Here is an example of my own, partly solved:
"My sister ___ going to cook dinner on Saturday."
Step 1: the subject is "my sister", so I need "is".
Step 2: after "going to" I use the base verb. The time expression is "on Saturday".

Your turn: write a sentence about your own plan for next weekend. Use "going to" and a time expression.
